info.name: RingCentral Adaptive Cards Call Monitoring Groups API

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the RingCentral account
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used)

params.name: page
params.description:
Indicates a page number to retrieve. Only positive number values
are allowed

params.name: perPage
params.description: Indicates a page size (number of items)

params.name: memberExtensionId
params.description:
Internal identifier of an extension that is a member of every
group within the result

items.docs: Returns a list of call monitoring groups filtered by an extension.
